prose: Short note from feed metadata only: Bloomberg (Debby Wu) reports that DeepSeek has open-sourced Super-Agent, a research prototype of a more autonomous coding agent that can monitor group chats for coding issues and propose solutions - a direct bid at the territory Anthropic's Claude Code owns. The source is paywalled, so the prototype's actual capabilities, license and evaluation claims are unverified here.
highlights: DeepSeek open-sources Super-Agent, a proactive coding-agent research prototype
Pitch: monitors group chats for coding issues and suggests solutions
Framed as a challenge to Claude Code's territory
Paywalled source; capabilities and license unverified
